title: State Machine UI Pattern — React Examples
title_es: Patrón State Machine para UI — Ejemplos en React
description: Runnable finite-state-machine examples for UI: useReducer FSM, XState fetch machine with guarded retries, checkout wizard, dropdown, auth guards, hierarchical upload machine, and actor-model batch uploads.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de máquinas de estados finitos para UI: FSM con useReducer, máquina XState de fetch con reintentos con guarda, wizard de checkout, dropdown, guardas de auth, máquina jerárquica de subida y subidas en lote con modelo de actores.
